settings.aboutText: Discover carefully selected Korean skincare for cleansing, hydration, treatment and daily protection. Product information, prices, offers and store content are editable from the admin panel.

hero.title: Skin, the Korean way.
hero.description: A premium collection of Korean skincare essentials for simple, thoughtful routines.

products.name: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser
products.description: Gentle daily gel cleanser for a fresh, balanced routine.
products.usage: Wet face, massage a small amount gently, then rinse with lukewarm water.

products.name: Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun SPF50+ PA++++
products.description: Lightweight daily sun protection with a comfortable finish.
products.usage: Apply generously as the final morning skincare step and reapply during prolonged outdoor exposure.

products.name: Anua Heartleaf 77% Soothing Toner
products.description: A soothing toner designed for a calm, hydrated feel.
products.usage: After cleansing, pat an appropriate amount over face and neck.

products.name: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Ampoule
products.description: Centella-focused ampoule for a lightweight soothing routine.
products.usage: Apply a few drops after toner and gently pat until absorbed.

products.name: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Essence
products.description: Hydrating essence with a silky, cushiony feel.
products.usage: Apply a small amount after cleansing and toning, then pat gently.

products.name: Beauty of Joseon Dynasty Cream
products.description: Rich yet elegant cream for a nourished finish.
products.usage: Use as the final skincare step; adjust amount to your skin's needs.

products.name: SKIN1004 Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum
products.description: Serum-like daily UV protection with a fresh texture.
products.usage: Apply evenly to exposed skin as the final morning step.

products.name: Laneige Water Sleeping Mask
products.description: Overnight moisture care for a refreshed morning feel.
products.usage: Apply an even layer as the last step at night and rinse in the morning.

products.name: Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Cream
products.description: Comforting daily moisturizer for a hydrated routine.
products.usage: Apply after serum or essence and gently pat into skin.

products.name: Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Serum
products.description: Hydration-focused serum for a plump, fresh feel.
products.usage: Use 2–3 drops after toner and before moisturizer.

products.name: rom&nd Glasting Melting Balm
products.description: Glossy Korean lip color with a soft balm-like feel.
products.usage: Swipe directly onto lips and layer for desired intensity.

products.name: Some By Mi AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Mask
products.description: Weekly mask option for a refreshed skincare ritual.
products.usage: Apply a thin layer, leave according to product directions, then rinse thoroughly.
